title: DentalGemma local validation run report
description: Machine-readable record of one local DentalGemma inference attempt. Written by scripts/run_dentalgemma.py to output/run_report.json. 'status' is UNKNOWN until a run is attempted, and OPERATIONAL only when the runtime exited 0 AND non-empty generated text exists on disk.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the report was written.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the run finished.

model.description: The model under test, as named by the lab.

finetune_model.description: The community dental fine-tune repository id.

gguf_repository.description: Repository the GGUF files came from.

gguf_revision.description: Pinned repository revision, so results are tied to exact bytes.

main_artifact.description: Path to the main language-model GGUF.

mmproj_artifact.description: Path to the multimodal projector GGUF.

main_size_bytes.description: Observed size of the main GGUF in bytes.

mmproj_size_bytes.description: Observed size of the projector GGUF in bytes.

main_sha256.description: LOCAL SHA-256 of the main GGUF. Null when not computed.

mmproj_sha256.description: LOCAL SHA-256 of the projector GGUF. Null when not computed.

runtime.description: The inference runtime: name, binary path and version line.

cpu.description: CPU model string of the machine that ran the job.

cuda.description: Whether an NVIDIA CUDA-capable GPU was detected on the machine that ran the inference. This lab never requires one. null in a template, because no machine has been measured yet.

intel_gpu.description: Intel display adapter detection (Iris Xe and friends).

input.description: Path to the image sent to the model.

input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the input image, for reproducibility. Never commit the image itself.

input_image.description: Probed properties of the input image (format, width, height, mode).

command.description: The exact argv that was (or would be) executed. Recorded verbatim so a run can be reproduced or challenged.

config.description: Sampling and runtime configuration (ctx, predict, temp, seed, threads, ngl).

inference_success.description: True only when the runtime exited 0 AND non-empty generated text exists. Never set from intention.

inference_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the process, in seconds.

peak_ram_gb.description: Peak resident/working set of the child process in GiB. Sampled, not profiled; null when no probe worked.

cpu_seconds.description: CPU time consumed by the child process, in seconds, where measurable.

memory_probe.description: Which probe produced the memory figure, so it is never quoted without its origin.

output_path.description: Path to the generated text. Null when nothing was generated.

output_chars.description: Length of the generated text, in characters.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the runtime process.

timed_out.description: True when the child was killed after exceeding the configured timeout.

status.description: UNKNOWN: not attempted. BLOCKED: a prerequisite is missing. FAILED: attempted and did not produce usable text. OPERATIONAL: exited 0 with non-empty generated text on disk.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about anything unusual, including why a status was chosen.

generated_text_preview.description: First part of the generated text, for quick inspection. The full text lives in the response file.

capture.description: How the runtime's bytes were captured, decoded and preserved. The .raw files hold the child's bytes unmodified; the readable .txt/.log files have ANSI escapes removed and invalid UTF-8 replaced, and both of those steps are counted here so a substitution made by this lab can never be mistaken for text the model produced.

encoding.description: Encoding used to decode the captured bytes.

stdout_decode_replacements.description: Byte sequences on stdout that were not valid UTF-8 and became U+FFFD.

output_integrity.description: What the runtime did to the text before this lab saw it. llama.cpp writes [UNK_BYTE_0x...] into the generated text when its detokenizer cannot map a token piece (see OUTPUT_DECODING.md); those markers are counted and preserved, never removed. `decoding_clean` false does not change `status`.

decoding_clean.description: True only when the runtime emitted no markers and no byte needed replacing.

status_semantics.description: How each status must be earned.

oneOf.title: Not attempted. The committed template stays here.
A prerequisite is missing: no runtime, no artifacts, no image.
The model ran and produced no usable text, or crashed.
Exit code 0 and a non-empty response file exists. Requires a real local run.
